changes.longitudeUnwrap: Each closed ring is unwrapped sequentially, then shifted by a whole-world multiple toward one canonical country reference.
changes.projection: Country-local equirectangular coordinates use longitude delta times cos(mean latitude), with latitude centered at the country mean.
changes.simplification: Fixed-stride vertex dropping was replaced by deterministic Douglas-Peucker simplification of two closed-ring arcs.
changes.topology: Exterior rings and every hole remain separate closed rings.
changes.worldCopies: The calculation returns one canonical longitude in [-180,180]; the renderer remains responsible for copies.

limitations: Douglas-Peucker preprocessing is materially slower than the removed stride thinning; performance optimization is deferred to 7N.
The simplifier is topology-aware at ring structure level but does not perform global self-intersection repair.
China and Chile still miss later insideRatio quality thresholds; candidate and footprint work belongs to 7E and 7F.
Generated 2020 label data was not regenerated in this scoped step, so checked-in metrics still represent the prior generator run.
